language.title: Language
language.subtitle: App language for UI, coach voice, and Wger exercise text.

coach.title: Coach voice
coach.subtitle: Choose a male or female voice for coach announcements during a session.
coach.unsupported: Speech is not supported in this browser.
coach.noLocaleFemale: No {{locale}} female voice — using system female voice
coach.noLocaleMale: No {{locale}} male voice — using system male voice
coach.pitchAdjusted: Pitch adjusted (no matching gendered voice found)

garmin.title: Garmin & recovery
garmin.subtitle: Show recovery and heart rate during prep and session. Set recovery manually; optionally connect a BLE heart-rate band for live HR on phone and TV.
garmin.wearableOn: Recovery and HR visible on Home, prep, and TV
garmin.wearableOff: Off — no recovery or HR data
garmin.hrConnecting: Connecting… pick your band in the browser
garmin.hrHint: Chrome or Edge on Android/desktop. Safari/iOS does not support Web Bluetooth. Reps and velocity come later via Connect IQ.

wger.title: Wger translation
wger.subtitle: When Wger text is not available in your app language, translate it and cache it locally.
wger.privacy: Needs internet on import or language switch. Text is sent through a free translation service, then stored locally.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Workouts, locker, and sessions stay on device. Only Wger exercise text may optionally be translated online.
